about: Development evidence that is not part of the public repository. Only aggregate counts are reproduced here; per-claim records (which include held-out claim identifiers) are not published.

quote_attestation_replay.source: Author's local folder outputs/release_review/quote-attestation-replay-20261023/ (results.json, FINDINGS.md, DECISION.md); not in this repository
quote_attestation_replay.what_was_done: Offline replay of recorded verifier outputs from 17 development runs: each decisive quote (the sentence the verifier cites for SUPPORTS or CONTRADICTS) was checked for whether it occurs as contiguous text of its passage. No model was called.

hypothetical_verdict_changes.assumption: Counterfactual only: those stances set to NEUTRAL, verdict rule unchanged

interpretation: About 28% of decisive quotes (185 of 653) in these recordings are not contiguous text of their passage, and the legacy check accepted them.
This does not establish that those stances are wrong: many look like number-copying errors by the 4B model (85 of 185 contain a number absent from the passage).
185 rejected quotes, 116 affected records and 23 hypothetical verdict changes are three different counts.
The hypothetical changes run in both directions against the reference labels; nothing here supports adopting a verdict gate.
quote_attestation_replay.decision: Quote attestation stays record-only and opt-in (--quote-attestation); it never changes a verdict. Verdict gating, accuracy or hallucination claims based on this replay: NO-GO.
limitations: Development claim sets only; one model (qwen3:4b).
Claims repeat across runs, so counts are per record, not per claim.
No manual review of whether stances are correct.
